rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for items arranged in a line.

example.english: The alignment of the books is very neat, forming a straight line on the shelf.
example.traditional: 啲書排列得好整齊，擺喺書架上成一直線。
example.jyutping: di1 syu1 paai4 lit6 dak1 hou2 zing2 cai4 baai2 hai2 syu1 gaa2 soeng6 sing4 jat1 zik6 sin3

rows.note: Use this for the alignment or registration of mechanical parts so that their positions match.

example.english: The technician said the machine's gear alignment was off and needed readjusting.
example.traditional: 師傅話部機啲齒輪對位唔準，要重新調校。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 waa6 bou6 gei1 di1 ci2 leon4 deoi3 wai6 m4 zeon2 jiu3 cung4 san1 tiu4 gaau3
